fit_reason: Whole private-party car (1993 Lincoln Mark VIII) listed by its owner.
findings: Leather driver seat shows heavy creasing and wear on the bolster and cushion
Dusty, dull interior surfaces on dash, console and door panel
Gray carpet in driver footwell looks dirty and matted
Loose items (spray can, cloth) left on the driver seat in the interior photo
Blue paint on hood, roof and trunk looks hazy with dust and light grime in spots, could use a polish to bring back depth
Chrome and lower body trim along the sides look dusty
message: Hi Kevin, we saw your listing for the 1993 Mark VIII. The leather seats and carpet look like they could really come back with a deep clean and conditioning, and a polish would bring out more shine in that blue paint. We do pre-sale details and come to you. Would you like a quote?
